properties.title: NRC Report: Hydraulic Oil in Long Island Sound near Norwalk, CT
properties.summary: Incident Type: VESSEL - NRC Report ID: 972524 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: NEXANS NORWAY AS
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 972524
Incident Time: 2011-04-10 15:30:00
Nearest City: Norwalk, CT
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: HYDRAULIC OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: NEXANS NORWAY AS
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 0.26 gallons
THE C/S SKAGERRAK CURRENTLY WORKING IN LONG ISLAND SOUND LOWERED AN ARGUS ROV TO PERFORM SUBSURFACE FUNCTIONS. WHILE MOBILIZING INTO POSITION A SENSOR INDICATED A CHANGE IN HYDRAULIC PRESSURE IN A COMPENSATOR AND THE ROV WAS IMMEDIATELY RAISED AND BROUGHT BACK ON DECK TO PERFORM DIAGNOSTICS. NO FLUID LOSS WAS OBSERVED ON THE SURFACE OF THE WATER WHEN THE ROV WAS RAISED. CONTINUED OBSERSAVTIONS CONCLUDED AFTER 30 MINUTES WITH NO FLUIDS OBSERVED. DURING INSPECTION IT WAS DETERMINED THAT A COMPENSATOR HAD WATER INGRESS AND RELEASED FROM THE INCREASED PRESSURE. THE REMAINING HYDRAULIC FLUID WAS DRAINED AND CONTAINERIZED. IT WAS DETERMINE THAT APPROXIMATELY 1/2 TO 1 LITER OF HYDRAULIC OIL WAS RELEASED IN THE INCIDENT WHICH OCCURRED AT A DEPTH OF 63 METERS BELOW THE WATERS SURFACE.
